facts.fact: 下一站是 Brainerd；Conrad 跳崖的消息传回保留地后成了玩笑，大家说他把自己 “brainer’d” 了。
facts.anchor: All she wanted to have in her head was their next stop: Brainerd, which had been the joke circulating after word of Conrad’s jump made it back to the reservation: he’d got himself “brainer’d.”

facts.fact: 行车途中 Yellow Tail 猛地前倾，脸砸在桌面上，吐出一线无色胆汁，眼睛立刻湿了。
facts.anchor: Which was when he jerked forward all at once, his face slamming into the tabletop, his left hand and arm wrapped around his stomach, his mouth and throat opening so he could throw up a thin line of colorless bile, his eyes immediately full and wet and imploring, asking the world why this, why him, why now?

facts.fact: Mooch Pease 十五岁那年看 Trace Lomas 骑枣红马照看牲口（从 Backbone 到 Sweet Grass Hills），便深深爱上他；她妈妈伸手捏她膝上的肉想吓退她。
facts.anchor: Trace Lomas sitting up on that sorrel mare, the horse wheeling back and forth under him, his head switching left and right to watch his livestock, the road, the whole world from the Backbone to the Sweet Grass Hills—Mooch Pease, just fifteen, had fallen in love hard enough that her mom had reached across to squeeze the meat above her knee, trying to scare her off this man.

facts.fact: Trace 的妈妈住在养老院；他们去看她时，她抚着 Trace 的脸侧、当众说他是好的 Browning Indian、最好的 Browning Indian。
facts.anchor: His mom in the old folks’ home, when they’d go see her, she’d run her hand along the side of his face and say for anyone within hearing that he was a good Browning Indian, the best Browning Indian.

facts.fact: Mooch 只愿记住丈夫骑在马上的样子，而不是他躺在岩石檐下的死状（脸颊干着呕吐物、下身污黑、双眼空瞪）；把他弄成那样的 Plenty Wolf 当时在浅洞更深处昏睡，一条手臂垫着头。
facts.anchor: She can remember him like that instead of lying under a rock overhang, vomit dried on his cheek, crotch dark with accident, eyes blank and staring. The one who made him like that passed out deeper in that shallow cave, her arm extended to pillow her head.

facts.fact: Mooch 与 Leech Lake 男孩之间放着一加仑腌菜罐，里面是 Conrad 的骨灰；若 Trace 在那次跳崖后仍活着，夫妻俩本会一起开车来运回遗体，如今她只能等车捎来。
facts.anchor: Between them, in a gallon pickle jar, was Conrad. His ashes. If Trace had still been alive after the jump, they would have driven out here together, brought his actual body back. Without him, Mooch had had to wait for a ride.

facts.fact: Leech Lake 男孩说要在明年夏天替 Conrad 完成那一跳；Conrad 从没对 Mooch 说过这男孩是他男友，但有些事当妈的一看便知。
facts.anchor: “I’m gonna make that jump for him next summer,” the boy said back. Conrad had never told her this was his boyfriend, but some things a mom just knows.

facts.fact: Mooch 一边亲吻男孩一边把他推开，喝止他：不许跳，Conrad 不会要你跳。
facts.anchor: “No,” Mooch said, kissing him and pushing him away at the same time. “You’re not, do you hear me? He wouldn’t want you to.
